teams.synopsis: To nobodys surprise, Baylen rings number one again.
teams.blurb: To nobodys surprise, Baylen rings number one again. The team has been electric with the emergence of Luther Burden and Tony Pollard. Combine that with the bench, this just may be one of the best preach teams in history if they can keep it up. Not much to say here besides, Heavy is the head that wears the crown.

teams.synopsis: Just a solid win this week keeps Chuck near the top of the leaderboard.
teams.blurb: Just a solid win this week keeps Chuck near the top of the leaderboard. Its hard to poke a hole in his lineup, especially with the emergence of Superstar tight end Chig Okonkwo. If there would to be one, it would be a flex, but he just beat a team starting keon coleman, Omar cooper, and caleb douglas, there are much worse options. Consistent quarterback play and Jahmyr Gibbs can keep him in any game.

teams.synopsis: Ben is in dire need of a qb after the loss of Lamar Jackson, but his record and his team still have strength.
teams.blurb: Ben is in dire need of a qb after the loss of Lamar Jackson, but his record and his team still have strength. The injury bug is biting, but if the rest of his team can pick up the slack, he may just keep his historic righting of course. The biggest question mark right now is Kyle Monangai, Ben needs the depth. Only time will tell how the rest of his season will go.

teams.synopsis: Another big win for Aidan sees him just outside of the top 3.
teams.blurb: Another big win for Aidan sees him just outside of the top 3. Javonte Williams and Bhayshul Tuten just might be the best running back room in the league, and you can’t forget about Ja’Marr Chase. Even with Mike Evans and Chris Olave missing from his lineup this week, he got the job done. I have a feeling this could be Aidans year, if he can keep this pace up, there just might be a deep playoff run in his future.

teams.synopsis: Quite possibly one of the most controversial seasons in preach history, but that doesn’t phase him.
teams.blurb: Quite possibly one of the most controversial seasons in preach history, but that doesn’t phase him. Despite the rumors of being a matchup fiend, Max showed a strong performance this week led by Tee Higgins. Saquon Barkley returning could propel this team to the next level, but that eagles offense has severe question marks. I have no choice but to give the flowers to the team that is 6-2, but the schedule still has some power.

teams.synopsis: Despite a loss in week 8, Anthony remains a good team to compete with.
teams.blurb: Despite a loss in week 8, Anthony remains a good team to compete with. Braelon Allen has been a beast, and its hard to see Breece Hall coming back and taking over all of the carries. Parker Washington has been hit or miss, and it has really shown, as Anthony has lost games his team normally wins. But if AJ Brown can return to full strength, that team is dangerous.

teams.synopsis: The RB duo of Josh Jacobs (sick deplorable piece of shit, he should not be allowed to be on a roster) and Bucky Irving have turned into one of the best in the league.
teams.blurb: The RB duo of Josh Jacobs (sick deplorable piece of shit, he should not be allowed to be on a roster) and Bucky Irving have turned into one of the best in the league. With a solid team about him, Deniz has been finding a way to win consistently, and as some other managers in this league show, all you have to do is beat the man infront of you. If Carnell Tate can get healthy, and Antonio Williams takes over, this team might just be dangerous. But then again, that can be said about any team.

teams.synopsis: The loss of Lamar Jackson seemed to ruin Flowers fantasy outlook, but Jacoby Brissett may have just saved Ethans season.
teams.blurb: The loss of Lamar Jackson seemed to ruin Flowers fantasy outlook, but Jacoby Brissett may have just saved Ethans season. Swift looks like he is a bonafide rb1, and Jonah Coleman may have just taken over the Broncos runningback room. While there are a lot of teams in the hunt right now, and many of them could be ranked above or below ethan(I feel the 6-10 spots are all interchangeable), always bet on Radecki.

teams.synopsis: What is there to be said about Quin?
teams.blurb: What is there to be said about Quin? Soft, pretty boy, a bitch. After a hot stretch, it seems like he has done nothing but slow down. He really missed Nabers this week, and his addition of Bijan has been underwhelming. But sitting at 4-4, the roster is solid, Maye is performing very well and there is solid weekly upside. Right now, the season is depended on Devonta Smith, and if he can get back on the field.

teams.synopsis: Andrew sports a very solid roster, and there were teams who did much worse than he did this past week.
teams.blurb: Andrew sports a very solid roster, and there were teams who did much worse than he did this past week. But there is nothing you can do against the juggernaut that are the Station Grits. But despite this, Andrew remains in the hunt for a playoff spot, he’s dealt with injuries before, but he has to hope that Justin Jefferson can get it going with the subpar QB play they see in Minnesota. Don’t count him out, but nows the time.

teams.synopsis: With a win this week, Ryan has put himself in the right direction.
teams.blurb: With a win this week, Ryan has put himself in the right direction. But he still sports a 3-5 record. Joe Burrow seems to be the man, and as he said, it feels like every time the tv flips to the bengals, Joe Burrow is throwing a touchdown. If Christian McCaffrey and George Kittle can stay healthy, and Ryan can keep on winning games, maybe we will see fantasy become great again.

teams.synopsis: A big win for Brandon against one of the top dogs in the league, even though they only scored 65 points, a win is a win.
teams.blurb: A big win for Brandon against one of the top dogs in the league, even though they only scored 65 points, a win is a win. Jaylen Warren has been incredible for him, but Jonathan Taylor needs to pick it up, whether that’s in Indianapolis or somewhere else. He comes upon a big chance to right the ship this next week, and he sees a familiar face in Gegwich, who he has DOMINATED historically.

teams.synopsis: Another rough loss for Carmine, but if he can point to anything it’s that Nico Collins and Isaiah Likely were on bye.
teams.blurb: Another rough loss for Carmine, but if he can point to anything it’s that Nico Collins and Isaiah Likely were on bye. He will need both of those players to hit their stride quickly if he has any chance of turning the season around, unfortunately for him, Breece Hall doesn’t look to be the clear RB1 that he was drafted as. It will be interesting to see how him and Braelon Allen, who has the hot hand, will share the rock when he’s back. I will never say that a season is over if there is any amount of a chance, but now is the time.

teams.synopsis: Not much to be said for Coles season, especially with Jeremiyah Love now being placed on the IR.
teams.blurb: Not much to be said for Coles season, especially with Jeremiyah Love now being placed on the IR. Unfortunate for a team that had so much promise to be great. With the worst record in the league, Cole will hope for a miracle to right the ship, but it seems someone has cut his sail.

matchup_of_the_week.blurb: This should be a fun one, when an unstoppable force meets an immovable object. Andrew owns Max all-time 6 to 1, but I have a feeling their 2026 matchup will be a different story. Over under 34.5 texts sent between these two on Sunday?
